description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of various models across three different tasks: Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy. The horizontal axis represents the model categories—Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE—listed alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy / Correlation,” presents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 with tick marks every 0.2.  For each model category, there are three bars grouped together, representing the three tasks; Sentiment Accuracy is represented by peach-colored bars, STS Correlation by teal bars, and Paraphrase Accuracy by pink bars. In the Single-task_baseline category, the peach bar extends to approximately 0.52, the teal bar to approximately 0.68, and the pink bar to approximately 0.54. The bars for the 2-Tier SimCSE category reach approximately 0.76, 0.78, and 0.79 respectively. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, outlining, or annotation.
